# Project Instructions

- This repository is a CodeIgniter 4 web application, so prioritize framework conventions over generic PHP patterns.
- Keep changes compatible with PHP 7.4+ and the existing Composer dependencies.
- Prefer editing the relevant controller, model, helper, or view together rather than changing one layer in isolation.
- Preserve existing routes, naming conventions, and user-facing behavior unless the task explicitly requires a change.
- For database-related work, inspect existing models and migrations before introducing new logic.
- Keep security and validation practices consistent with CodeIgniter 4 best practices.
